text: I love the depth of this pan and the extra handle. I love the depth of this pan and the extra handle.  The dome lid is wonderful when cooking a small pan roast. description: Ecolution Evolve is available in stunning new shades of Crimson Red, Copper Bronze, New Moon Blue and Black, the cookware has soft, squeezable, silicone stay-cool handles that are comfortable to grip. Adding to its performance and ease of use, the cookware features Hydrolon, an ecologically advanced water-based non-stick coating made without PFOA for greater safety. The heavy aluminum bottom of the pan features a decorative pattern and textured heat bands for even heating and better culinary results. Oven safe to 350 degrees Fahrenheit, the pans are ideal for electric, gas and glass ceramic cook tops and are dishwasher safe.
